_about: Every spoken template for Baby Hoover V3. No broadcast English lives in the Python source: V3Booth._text selects a variant by deterministic rotation (DEC-11), fills its placeholders, and returns. Placeholders are validated at load against each kind's supply set. A variant may declare `when` (facts that must match) and its required placeholders are inferred from the template text -- a variant whose placeholders the context cannot supply is skipped, so cause/no-cause and named/unnamed forms need no code branch. British broadcast register; LEAD calls the present, ANALYST reaches one step for meaning.
